content: If the return ed value is ‘ DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT ’ and the ‘ FreezeFrameKind ’ is set to ’ DEM_J1939DCM_SPNS_IN_EXPANDED_FREEZEFRAME ’ the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall add to the response message all SPNs which are only supported in J1939DcmSPNsIn DataStream and not in the ExpandedFreezFrame (returned by [SWS_J1939Dcm_00094] ). The bit 2 ‘Supported in Data Stream’ in ‘SPN support type’ sha ll be set to 0 and the ‘SPN Data Length’ shall be set to 0x00. Afterwards PduR_J1939DcmTransmit shall be triggered with the PduId of the requested message and set the destination address (via MetaData) according to the source address of the request, or to 0xFF when the destination of the request was 0xFF.
